newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Soaring Chicago sparks late European feeds trade.
newsitem.headline: Soaring Chicago sparks late European feeds trade.

text.p: Soaring Chicago soymeal futures in the first 90 minutes of trading sparked late nearby South American soymeal trade this afternoon, dealers said.

"Chicago soymeal futures rose to over $7 for July in the first hour and a half of trading which caused operators here to cover nearby needs in Argentine soymeal late in the afternoon. Otherwise the market remained slow due to a strong dollar," one broker said.
Arrived Argentine soymeal pellets traded from $273.50 and $276 a tonne cif Rotterdam, afloat at $279 and June at $278.
